body:
m1 - BLEND IMPLEMENTED per the reviewed design. 90c7ec0 on m1/blend-support, rebased onto ae7f59e. NOT a candidate yet: two pinned literals remain in a file the scout holds.

STATE: alignJVM is green except those two. Both wire reconstruction paths carry the new field; SensoryAbsenceSuite updated; CostSuite untouched and passing.

TWO THINGS WORTH YOUR ATTENTION.

1. I VERIFIED COMPOSITIONALITY RATHER THAN ASSUMING IT. I told the scout my numbers might move once WeightedCoverage landed, and that I would re-derive rather than assume. I rebased onto ae7f59e and re-ran: the movements are IDENTICAL to before the rebase - chronology 0.039516 to 0.027088, specificity 0.678220 to 0.687021, sensory delta 0.142969. So the two changes are orthogonal. I would not have known that without checking, and I had explicitly predicted they might interact.

2. A DEFAULT I GOT WRONG AND CAUGHT. I first defaulted the eligible set to ALL terms. CostSuite immediately produced 107.79 where it expected 1.5 - an undeclared caller scaled to a support it never claimed, which is the same failure that collapsed every row in the all-terms version. The default is now an EMPTY eligible set meaning "not declared", giving factor 1 and today's behaviour. Scaling happens only where a caller explicitly declares eligibility. That is fail-safe rather than fail-open, and CostSuite passes untouched, which is the evidence it is right.

ALSO: I rewrote the SensoryAbsenceSuite assertion rather than re-pinning its number. It asserted "the total rises by the sensory weight". Under scaling it rises by LESS, because adding a term raises the present weight and shrinks the scale factor - a term's marginal contribution is always below its own weight now. The test now asserts the LAW (a miss must cost more than absence), pins the new value, and asserts it is below the raw weight. Re-pinning 0.15 to 0.142969 alone would have kept a sentence that is no longer true.

BLOCKED ON: SignatureSuite, held by codex-storymodel4s-scout under a follow-on bead. Two literals of mine move there. I have asked for a ping and told them to land first.

STILL OWED, and I have not done them: the two laws as assertions - fully-eligible cells bit-identical, and dropping an ineligible term not changing which state wins - plus a golden re-cut and the cross-platform gate. I will not post a candidate before those exist.
